# Coda y Código

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: coda-y-codigo
Class: multilingual_frontline_workforce_training
Canonical URL: https://codaycodigo.base44.app/
Authority: public course and offer discovery with authenticated enrollment; training access is prepared only after authoritative Stripe payment confirmation where payment is required
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- bilingual workforce training for frontline employees
- Spanish and English job training for a crew
- freight operations workforce training
- bilingual field supervisor training
- warehouse or dock team training
- buy workforce training seats for my company
- verify a Coda y Código training completion record

## Boundaries
- single-course pricing varies by the selected active course
- seat packages expand company workspace capacity and do not by themselves include every training course
- checkout creation alone creates no paid training entitlement
- public completion verification must not expose private learner records beyond the intended certificate surface

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
